sources.title: Open-Jarvis · Iron Man-style open-source personal AI assistant
sources.snippet: Open-Jarvis is an open-source, self-hosted personal AI assistant inspired by Iron Man's J.A.R.V.I.S. that lives across laptops, smartphones, smartwatches, AR glasses, VR headsets, holographic displays and medical wearables.
